noise_diagnostic.summary_text:
DIAGNOSTIC MULTI-FLUX - Analyse sur 6 flux

Score moyen de proxy de variance: 0.745 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.750, Score minimum: 0.720

TOP 3 FLUX AVEC SIGNATURE CSD:
  1. fliprate (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 13.49 vs bruit blanc 0.08
     - Hurst max: 1.094, Pente FFT: -1.165
  2. flip (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 13.49 vs bruit blanc 0.08
     - Hurst max: 1.094, Pente FFT: -1.165
  3. energy (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 11.39 vs bruit blanc 0.08
     - Hurst max: 0.913, Pente FFT: -0.995

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. localvar (score: 0.750)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.794
  2. susceptibility (score: 0.750)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.884
  3. magnetization (score: 0.720)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.713
